readout_other: Laser speckle contrast imaging (% change in CBF) and intrinsic optical signal imaging (change in OD, total haemoglobin)
direction_notes: Ultrasound increased CBF and total haemoglobin in somatosensory cortex, scaling with pulse train duration and pressure; no consistent dependence on pulse duration or PRF. Neural activity was not recorded.
safety_notes: Thermal effects assessed by calculation (maximum tissue rise 0.03 C; transducer surface rise 1.3 C).

exposures.label: Transparent ultrasound transducer cranial window over somatosensory cortex, 12 MHz

device.model: In-house lithium niobate transparent ultrasound transducer (TUT), 3 x 3 mm

timing.protocol_description: Seven trials per recording, 30 s apart; main protocol PRF 1000 Hz, pulse duration 500 us, PNP 486.2 kPa, pulse train duration 250 ms. Pulse train duration varied 25-250 ms, PNP 230.8-486.2 kPa, pulse duration 100-500 us and PRF 100-1000 Hz one at a time.
